title: SettlementPayload
description: Payload passed to Person 3's smart contract scripts (settle.py or refundAndPenalize.py)

payment_id.description: Payment ID corresponding to locked escrow on-chain

action.description: Action to be executed by the escrow smart contract

agent_address.description: Algorand address of the AI agent receiving refund or providing payment

provider_address.description: Algorand address of the service provider receiving settlement or being penalized

slash_amount.description: Bond penalty slashed from provider in micro-USDC (on SLA failure)

reason.description: Summary reason for this settlement or refund action
